76:t_003:3.en:
$$レド$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is an enemy of the Alliance.」

76:t_003:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「There is no $$人類銀河同盟$$ here.」

76:t_003:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「What's wrong with that? If they're offering to help.」

76:t_003:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's right. In this world, it's all give and take.」

76:t_003:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Presumed to be a term denoting the concept of mutual assistance.」

76:t_003:10.en:
$$レド$$
「There are quite a lot of words for mutual assistance.」

76:t_003:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Presumed to be a characteristic of this planet.」

76:t_003:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Perfect timing, $$レド$$! Try out the new weapon I built!」

76:t_003:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I call it the $$ピニオン$$ Halberd! Smash 'em!」

76:t_003:15.en:
$$レド$$
「Not necessarily. Judging by the other units of $c, close combat is an effective tactic.」

76:t_003:16.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$スカル$$ 1 to all units! Target the enemy ship $$ギルター$$ is aboard!」

76:t_003:17.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Take that ship down and wrap this up fast!」

76:t_004:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Curses! These wretches are infuriating to no end!」

76:t_004:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't want to hear that from a coward like you!」

76:t_004:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Be careful, $$ガロード$$! Something's coming!」

76:t_006:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「More $$サイデリアル$$ reinforcements?」

76:t_006:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「But it looks like they were attacking $$ギルター$$'s unit as well as us.」

76:t_006:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Watch out! Something else is coming!」

76:t_007:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't tell me these guys are...!」

76:t_007:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army and the $$ギシン星$$ combat robots!」

76:t_007:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Unwelcome interference today! Remember this, $c! The next time we meet will be your last!」

76:t_008:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy ship is retreating.」

76:t_008:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「For now, dealing with the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army comes first.」

76:t_008:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「What's going on!? Did those guys actually survive!?」

76:t_008:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Hold on. Something's definitely off here.」

76:t_008:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Confirmed. The $$小型円盤$$s and the $$ギシン星$$ combat robots are all unmanned.」

76:t_008:5.en:
$$さやか$$
「You mean nobody's riding in them?」

76:t_008:6.en:
$$ボス$$
「Then are those $$サイデリアル$$ mechs over there stolen and being used by somebody too...!」

76:t_008:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know the circumstances, but the fact is they attacked us.」

76:t_008:8.en:
$n
「We have no choice but to intercept.」

76:t_008:9.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But that means back-to-back battles. It's gonna be a little rough.」

76:t_008:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

76:t_008:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, intercept the unidentified enemy force. However, as we don't know what they are after, avoid taking undue risks.」

76:t_008:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I'm counting on your cooperation as well.」

76:t_009:1.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's OK, $$ティファ$$. I'm sure $$宗介$$ and $$ガロード$$ will take care of it.」

76:t_009:2.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Yes... Besides, the moon will be out soon.」

76:t_009:3.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The moon...? It's still a while until night, though...」

76:t_009:4.en:
$$ティファ$$
「That moon will become a light that illuminates the darkness.」

76:t_009:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unit confirmed approaching this area.」

76:t_009:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Negative on that possibility. Life signs confirmed aboard the approaching unit.」

76:t_010:0.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$ザンボット３$$, you say!」

76:t_010:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$勝平$$...! Is that you, $$勝平$$!?」

76:t_010:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yep! Long time no see, $$ワッ太$$!」

76:t_010:4.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$勝平$$! This is no time to be getting nostalgic!」

76:t_010:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「First, let's clear out the guys in front of us!」

76:t_010:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Like I don't know that already!」

76:t_011:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Perfect timing. Hey, if you're fighting alone, lend me and $$ザンボット３$$ a hand!」

76:t_011:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Though it is an unidentified unit, it is presumed to be an ally.」

76:t_011:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Understood. This unit will move to support.」

76:t_012:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm counting on you, $$勝平$$! They're unmanned, so don't hold back!」

76:t_012:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Leave it to me! I'll show you the great $$勝平$$ and $$ザンボット３$$ in action for the first time in ages!」

76:t_012:2.en:
$n
「The pilot of that giant robot... Is he an acquaintance of $$ワッ太$$?」

76:t_012:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's $$神勝平$$, and the robot he's piloting is $$ザンボット３$$. He's an old comrade of ours.」

76:t_012:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So the reason he'd gone missing is that he was on $$翠の地球$$.」

76:t_012:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here I come, robot army! A warm-up before fighting $$サイデリアル$$!」

76:t_012:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「The great $$神勝平$$ and $$ザンボット３$$ will take you on!!」

76:t_013:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「We took out all the enemies. It doesn't look like there are any reinforcements nearby either.」

76:t_013:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Well, that's a relief for now.」

76:t_013:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$... So those enemies today, they really are...」

76:t_013:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yeah... The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ may have been revived...」

76:t_013:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Give me a break! Just dealing with $$サイデリアル$$ is all we can handle. If that guy shows up too, there's no way we can cope!」

76:t_013:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't worry, $$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$! Now that $$ザンボット３$$ and I are here, whatever the enemy is, it's a piece of cake!」

76:t_013:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Tch... You never change, always so sure of yourself.」

76:t_013:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「What the heck! We haven't seen each other in ages, and that's how you talk to me!」
